whitespace/source-span differences do not change addressable lookup
opening never mutates or queries associative memory
releaseGate: reference challenge passes every positive and negative corpus vector

challenge remains unlinked from accepted mts-contract and mts-proof
publish an explicit versioned Accepted definition-opening contract before modifying production code
